title: The Morning Digest: October 16, 2026
dek: The delayed EIA report for the week ending October 9 printed a crude draw of 8.6 million barrels against a near-flat consensus, and WTI settled up 3.03 percent on Thursday while Brent eased. Kpler puts Hormuz clearance at 11.62 million barrels a day over the seven days to October 13, about 68 percent of baseline. The diesel crack printed $97.30 overnight after nine straight days above $100, a day after the IEA board accelerated the remaining emergency releases with more than 20 million barrels of diesel front-loaded. Ukraine has resumed refinery strikes in fact, with a refinery fire in Russia's Ryazan region. Canadian December widened on volume: WCS Dec26 settled at -$26.75 on 805 lots, and C5 Dec26 fell $1.25 to +$4.00.
